items.title: Dorothy Donegan — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Joe Sherman wanted to put me in a concert behind Vladimir Horowitz... this promoter, Joe Sherman, wanted me to stay a slave for life.

ctx.x: Joe Sherman, who worked for Joe Glaser. And he had beat up Lips Page. He hit him in the mouth. So we got a free vacation that week.
When did Joe Sherman come into your life. Was he your first manager?
